case_rule: For each seed and each fixed phase r0-5/r6-14/r15-20 choose argmax gain, argmin gain, and argmin abs(gain); ties lower round; overlapping choices retain all labels
followup: Evaluate cumulative gain through next 2/3 accepted batches when available, never extrapolate missing rounds; case is explanatory not independent confirmation
manual_science_sampling: All unique selected cases plus fixed seed-round grid r0/r5/r14/r20. Code-derived graph and identity flags are not semantic correctness
scientific_chain: Hypothesis, legal observed evidence, linked selected choices and same-molecule strict single-condition contrasts, selected observations, next hypothesis matching only as candidate lineage
truth_boundary: Only frozen preselection observed table and accepted selected feedback for that same trajectory; no canonical table, no candidate/test truth; no paid LLM or training
outcome_bias: Gain-selected cases are explicitly descriptive and cannot become confirmation samples
